messages.author: 4271370c9274971b
messages.subject: Changing dBref for PSD
parts:
Hi everybody,

The spectro/meanspec/spec functions allow for the changing of the dB reference level, but I'm unable to change the dBref when I'd like to return a PSD. Does anyone have insight into this? Is it relevant?

Thanks,

Sean

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Changing dBref for PSD
parts:
Hi Sean,

Actually, the 'dB' argument computes 20*log10(x) where x is the FFT, which is equivalent to 10*log10(x^2). This means that the result of a dB use is a PSD.
I have to say this is indeed not clear in the documentation and the error message returned is quite puzzling...

data(tico)
meanspec(tico, PSD = TRUE, dB = "max0")
Error in meanspec(tico, PSD = TRUE, dB = "max0") : PSD cannot be in dB

Note that there is no PSD argument in spectro().

I will do a correction.

All my apologies for this,

HTH

Jerome

Thanks

Sean

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Changing dBref for PSD
parts:
Yes. No need to set PSD=TRUE.
The y axis label is indeed kept unchanged (Amplitude (dB)). You can change it with the argument 'alab'.
Jerome
